title: Connection lost and cannot be reastablished on Unihertz Atom with Dexcom G5
body:
Unihertz Atom connected to Dexcom G5 .
xdrip is configured in OB1 in native mode.
Runs perfect with 100% readings rate for hours until the connection to G5 breaks.
xdrip can't establish the communication after that until the smartphone will be rebooted.

If i use the patched dexcom app of Milos, the connection breaks sometimes, but the dexcom app is able to reconnect every time the connection breaks. In this case no reboot is required.

In addition i logged the Atom smartphone for the Unihertz support. You can see the logs in:
https://drive.google.com/open?id=1C_AJ2N-esjgk0CEkTDxumeisYlX5j_XI


![screenshot_20181026-220201](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25795894/47673047-cf660a00-dbb3-11e8-970a-a7518a89851e.png)

comments.body: Did you try to use OB1 in non-native mode or old mode?
No , only OB1 in native mode, because i run SMB in AndroidAps.
